x: Bill Snell, who has showed much improved form this year, took the sealed handicap award; and it was pleasing to see a comparative newcomer in W.
Throughout Colin walked well within himself, and at an even pace, as though he were a veteran in experience on the Brighton road. No less meritorious was the walking of W.
